residual_risk: azguard:grants:prune and azguard:audit:prune without --tenant walk every tenant of the selected panels. That matches dossier 12 §3 and D24: the scheduled prune has no tenant argument, each tenant is its own ChangePipeline mutation, and --before cannot move forward or inside audit retention. A reset whose changing pipe throws keeps the old incarnation because renewIncarnation runs inside the mutate transaction; the engine race test covers lock ordering and the cached read, and the feature test covers refusal inside an already open transaction.
